Class Payment2TriggerHelper.AdjustmentAmounts

private class Payment2TriggerHelper.AdjustmentAmounts

Helper class to calculate and distribute adjustment amounts across different payment components (subtotal, tax, tip). Handles the breakdown of a total adjustment amount into its constituent parts.

Methods

public Payment2TriggerHelper.AdjustmentAmounts setAmount(
  Payment2TriggerHelper.AdjustmentAmountType amountType,
  Decimal amount
)

Allocates a specific amount to a given adjustment type from the remaining unallocated amount. Uses a builder pattern to allow method chaining. If the requested amount exceeds the remaining amount, only the remaining amount is allocated.

Parameters:
    amountType – The type of adjustment (subtotal, tax, or tip) to allocate the amount to
    amount – The amount to allocate to this adjustment type

Returns:
    This AdjustmentAmounts instance for method chaining
